description: This file defines the 'Barcode' class within the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel.Shapes namespace. The class models a barcode shape that can be added to documents, including properties like Code, Type, Orientation, and visual attributes. It provides methods for cloning, serialization, and access to internal property values, and is under development as indicated by the comment.

classes.name: Barcode
classes.description: Represents a barcode shape object for inclusion in documents, with properties for configuring barcode appearance and data.

classes.description: Contains the internal nullable properties for the Barcode class, representing various configurable options.

methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Barcode instance.

methods.description: Serializes the Barcode object into DDL format using a Serializer.
